Frequently Asked Questions

How do I convert Kilowatts to Metric Horsepower?
To convert Kilowatts (kW) to Metric Horsepower (PS), multiply the value by 1.359622. For example, 10 kW = 13.596216 PS.
How many Metric Horsepower are in 1 Kilowatt?
1 Kilowatt (kW) is equal to 1.359622 Metric Horsepower (PS).
Is this kW to PS converter accurate?
Yes. This converter uses exact conversion factors and performs real-time calculations client-side in your browser with zero rounding until display. It also supports cooking fractions (like 1/2, 2 1/2) and decimals.
Can I convert Metric Horsepower back to Kilowatts?
Yes! This is a two-way converter. Simply type a value in the Metric Horsepower field and the Kilowatts result will update instantly.
